steps.en: Start the Docker UI with model access and persistent report storage
steps.zh: 启动容器界面，配置模型与持久报告存储

steps.en: Submit a lawful investigation topic and select a model
steps.zh: 提交有授权的调查主题并选择模型

steps.en: Refines the query and searches engines through Tor
steps.zh: 改写查询并通过 Tor 搜索引擎

steps.en: Filters candidates, reads bounded page text and writes a summary
steps.zh: 筛选候选，读取有界正文并生成摘要

value.en: A source-linked first-pass investigation report instead of manual onion tab hopping
value.zh: 获得带来源的初步调查报告，不必手动逐页寻找
